evidence.title: Greenland reports split on genocide claim over forcible contraception

occurrences.checkable_against: Accepted inquiry report
occurrences.quote_span: The accepted report, however, did not conclude whether there was a genocide.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Greenland forced contraception inquiry

occurrences.checkable_against: Inquiry reports and Danish health program records
occurrences.quote_span: The alleged purpose was to limit population growth in Greenland by preventing pregnancies.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Greenland forced contraception inquiry

occurrences.checkable_against: Greenlandic government release and the two inquiry reports
occurrences.quote_span: On Friday, the Greenlandic government only accepted the findings of one of the reports, saying that an expert found that the second — the one that definitively said a genocide had not taken place — did not meet recognized scientific standards.
occurrences.speaker: Greenlandic government
occurrences.subject: Greenland forced contraception inquiry

occurrences.checkable_against: Mette Frederiksen's official apology statement
occurrences.quote_span: Danish Prime Minister Mette Frederiksen officially apologized last year.
occurrences.speaker: Mette Frederiksen
occurrences.subject: Greenland forced contraception inquiry

occurrences.checkable_against: Inquiry witness records and investigators’ case files
occurrences.quote_span: More than 350 Greenlandic Indigenous women and girls, including some 12 years old and younger, previously came forward to investigators and reported that they were forcibly given contraception by Danish health authorities .
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Greenland forced contraception inquiry

occurrences.checkable_against: Rejected inquiry report
occurrences.quote_span: “There is no empirical evidence to assume that any Danish or Greenlandic authority, or any individual healthcare professional, at any time had any intention of destroying the Greenlandic population or a significant proportion of it,” the authors of the rejected report wrote.
occurrences.speaker: authors of the rejected inquiry report
occurrences.subject: Greenland forced contraception inquiry

occurrences.checkable_against: Inquiry testimony, consent forms and medical records
occurrences.quote_span: They were not told details about the procedure, or did not give their consent.
occurrences.speaker: Inuit victims
occurrences.subject: Greenland forced contraception inquiry

occurrences.checkable_against: Greenlandic government release and Aug. 28, 2026 news conference transcript
occurrences.quote_span: The Greenlandic government, which commissioned the inquiry, released the reports Friday but, when pressed by journalists during a news conference, would not say whether its leaders concluded whether a genocide had occurred.
occurrences.speaker: Greenlandic government
occurrences.subject: Greenland forced contraception inquiry

occurrences.checkable_against: Danish health authority IUD records and inquiry report
occurrences.quote_span: Denmark says more than 4,000 women and girls — reportedly half the fertile women in Greenland at the time — received IUDs between the 1960s and mid-1970s.
occurrences.speaker: Denmark
occurrences.subject: Greenland forced contraception inquiry

occurrences.checkable_against: Inquiry terms of reference and the United Nations 1948 Genocide Convention
occurrences.quote_span: The government told the authors to use the definition under the United Nations’ 1948 genocide convention, which includes “imposing measures intended to prevent births within the group.”
occurrences.speaker: Greenlandic government
occurrences.subject: Greenland forced contraception inquiry

occurrences.checkable_against: Inquiry group records and the two published reports
occurrences.quote_span: The reports were originally supposed to be a single publication but two of the four members of the group broke away several months ago and wrote their own report.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Greenland forced contraception inquiry

occurrences.checkable_against: Accepted inquiry report
occurrences.quote_span: “It is difficult to imagine circumstances in which an attempt to substantially reduce the population of a single ethnic group could not constitute an intent to destroy, in part, that ethnicity,” the report said.
occurrences.speaker: authors of the accepted inquiry report
occurrences.subject: Greenland forced contraception inquiry

occurrences.checkable_against: Accepted inquiry report and its recommendations
occurrences.quote_span: The authors wrote that they were not able to determine if any intent to destroy the population existed solely through the forcible contraception cases, and suggested further study that encompassed other Danish practices at the time that affected Greenlandic children and families.
occurrences.speaker: authors of the accepted inquiry report
occurrences.subject: Greenland forced contraception inquiry

occurrences.checkable_against: The two Greenlandic government-commissioned inquiry reports
occurrences.quote_span: Two reports investigating the forcible contraception of thousands of Indigenous women and girls in Greenland by Danish health authorities for decades were split over whether the practice constituted genocide.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Greenland forced contraception inquiry

occurrences.checkable_against: Inquiry case chronology and health authority records
occurrences.quote_span: The cases occurred between the 1960s and the early 1990s.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Greenland forced contraception inquiry

occurrences.checkable_against: Greenland-Denmark governmental transfer records
occurrences.quote_span: Greenland took over its own healthcare programs on Jan. 1, 1992.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Greenland forced contraception inquiry

occurrences.checkable_against: Inquiry testimony and medical records
occurrences.quote_span: The Inuit victims, many of them teenagers at the time, said they were either fitted with intrauterine contraceptive devices, known as IUDs or coils, or given a hormonal birth control injection.
occurrences.speaker: Inuit victims
occurrences.subject: Greenland forced contraception inquiry

occurrences.checkable_against: Historical Greenland population statistics and public health records
occurrences.quote_span: The population on the Arctic island was rapidly increasing at the time because of better living conditions and better health care.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Greenland forced contraception inquiry

occurrences.checkable_against: Greenlandic government news release of Aug. 28, 2026
occurrences.quote_span: “The reason given was professional disagreements amongst the members and, to some extent, concerns about the geopolitical situation,” the Greenlandic government said Friday in a news release.
occurrences.speaker: Greenlandic government
occurrences.subject: Greenland forced contraception inquiry

occurrences.checkable_against: Rejected inquiry report
occurrences.quote_span: “There was no genocide.”
occurrences.speaker: authors of the rejected inquiry report
occurrences.subject: Greenland forced contraception inquiry
